source.caveat: Original weights/download and export chain were not independently verified. Hash pins the existing repository artifact, not its authenticity.

license.releaseBlocker: Owner must verify weights/export provenance and redistribution obligations before public release. No commercial terms accepted.

runtime.name: onnxruntime-web
runtime.execution: dedicated classic worker with lazy vendored UMD loader

graph.caveat: Embedded export args claim opset 17; graph inspection confirms opset 18.
graph.preprocessing: RGB / 255, NCHW; resize preserving aspect ratio with rounded dimensions; centered letterbox RGB 114; inverse uses actual horizontal and vertical resize scales

postprocessing.probabilityHandling: Accept bounded float32 sigmoid roundoff, clamp selected class score to [0,1]; reject larger excursions
postprocessing.coordinates: xywh center in input pixels; clip to source bounds; reject nonfinite/unsupported output; person-only greedy NMS

videoSampling.mode: current decoded frame, not unique-person tracking

unusedArtifact.reason: Graph has no external initializers. Not fetched by browser inference.

realInferenceSmoke.input: Generated 320x240 geometric canvas; no private media
realInferenceSmoke.scope: Production-subpath dedicated worker, actual pinned ONNX/WASM, real inference, cancellation/retry, no-upload network trace
realInferenceSmoke.limitation: Execution smoke only; no people/classroom accuracy, video, cross-browser or production CSP validation
